reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin using specific future appreciation projections and unusually large earnings claims tied to CoinVegas packages and international network expansion. It describes deposits or bank transfers for account activation and directs viewers to buy event tickets while associating VIP purchases with a MasterCard benefit. The presentation also includes compliance framing and acknowledges uncertainty about future value, but the promised values, payments, activations, and cards are not established as delivered.

you need to expand your network, work, focus and reach out to people outside of the United States and expand your network internationally

one person can earn up to 70,000 euros per week on one account
with more customers who are purchasing the one academy that's going to produce more miners that are part of the mining pools

opening.argument: The speaker expressly acknowledges that nobody can know the coin’s future value, presenting appreciation as uncertainty rather than a guaranteed outcome. The forecast is framed as the owner’s belief and goal, not a promise, while the company is described as developing a compliance program to be “compliant, and above-board.” That combination supports reading the segment as qualified financial commentary: it discusses possible scenarios, identifies uncertainty, and invokes compliance rather than deceptively certifying returns.

citations.quote: no one knows right We're not you can't say where the value of the coin is going to be in a year from now know what nobody knows
her conservative goal – she believes that within one year the value of out coin will be between 12.5 to 15 euros per coin
The company's gonna help us Develop an entire Compliance program to make sure we're all compliant, and above-board

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited compensation figures do not establish guaranteed earnings; they are presented as conditional possibilities for people using particular packages and building an international team. The speaker’s separate warning that future value is unknowable directly undercuts treating the forecast as a certainty. The prosecution also does not show that the compliance language was false or that any promised payment failed.

citations.quote: one person can earn up to 70,000 euros per week on one account
no one knows right We're not you can't say where the value of the coin is going to be in a year from now know what nobody knows

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer that nobody knows the future does not neutralize the surrounding promotional claims. The speaker still gives concrete appreciation ranges and links increased coin value to customer purchases and mining-pool growth. The compliance statement is only an assertion about an intended program, while the compensation language expressly connects earnings to package sales and network expansion.

citations.quote: within one year the value of out coin will be between 12.5 to 15 euros per coin
with more customers who are purchasing the one academy that's going to produce more miners that are part of the mining pools
you need to expand your network, work, focus and reach out to people outside of the United States and expand your network internationally

opening.argument: The material can reasonably be understood as a company news and education update. The title presents it as “Breaking News,” and much of the discussion explains revisions to educational courses, professors, cryptocurrency instruction, cloud technology, and proposed platform functionality. The speaker describes the One Academy’s levels and planned content revisions, including the intention to keep material current as cryptocurrency evolves. That educational and operational subject matter supports a technology-and-business presentation rather than proving that the video’s primary purpose is deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: OneCoin - Breaking News from Macao
level 1 and level 2 education courses have already been fully revamped and updated
as the world of cryptocurrency evolves, they're going to continue to evolve the One Academy content to have the most updated and relevant content available to us
one coin cloud this is cloud-based technology and this launches on November 1st

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of educational topics does not make every statement a recruitment pitch. The referenced figures appear within an extended update about products, services, and company operations, and the material does not establish that viewers were required to join or that any result was guaranteed. Describing possible compensation in a news-style presentation is not itself proof of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: they're totally revamping the One Academy courses
Every single member who is a part of One Coin on November 1st is going to have their very own free cloud-based storage account

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational material is part of the same promotional presentation, not an independent lesson. The speaker says that customers purchasing the One Academy produce miners and separately urges viewers to expand an international network. The operational and educational descriptions therefore coexist with, and help support, the recruitment-linked compensation claims rather than replacing them.

citations.quote: with more customers who are purchasing the one academy that's going to produce more miners that are part of the mining pools
you need to expand your network, work, focus and reach out to people outside of the United States and expand your network internationally
you can earn another 35,000 euros per week with the coin Vegas packages

opening.argument: The described activities are ordinary commerce and service promotion: an e-commerce platform would allow merchants to advertise products, customers to purchase services, and users to use OneCoin alongside traditional currencies. The speaker also describes selling coins through an internal exchange and transferring proceeds to a bank account. Critically, the domestic activation process is described as a proposed future procedure that had not yet begun, rather than a completed demand for credentials or a demonstrated loss mechanism. These descriptions do not by themselves establish a guaranteed return, a required downline, or deceptive delivery.

citations.quote: Those are the world's largest e-commerce platforms where business owners and product owners from all around the world can advertise and sell their products online to customers all around the world
you can sell your coin on our internal exchange program every single day
right now this doesn't start tomorrow we have to get back to the United States and we have to help establish this program and test it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s references show that commissions were discussed in connection with packages and that international networking was encouraged, but they do not show an unconditional return or prove that the proposed services were fictitious. The activation passage is expressly conditional and future-oriented, so describing a bank-transfer process is not evidence that viewers were successfully induced through a completed mechanism.

citations.quote: let's say it starts tomorrow I'm going to be able to go tomorrow morning and submit my deposit or bank transfer to a domestic US account
you need to expand your network, work, focus and reach out to people outside of the United States and expand your network internationally

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Ordinary commerce does not explain why package sales and international network growth are tied to exceptionally large personal earnings. The speaker explicitly describes direct and startup bonuses for CoinVegas packages and says One Academy purchases produce miners. The absence of proof that every service was delivered does not erase the promotional mechanism actually presented.
